Dan Morgenstern is one of the nation’s most respected jazz historians. He served as the director of the Institute of Jazz Studies at Rutgers from 1976-2010, and is a recipient of a Jazz Master Award from the National Endowment for the Arts. Dan was the editor of DownBeat magazine from 1964-1973, and has received eight Grammy awards for his liner note writing.
Dan was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 9, 2013 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
